purpose: Remaining fixed-global-input execution controls; no automatic promotion to long training
status_scope: Launch snapshot; live registry tracks later completion

plan.hypothesis: At fixed global input and sample stream, a larger microbatch ceiling improves execution throughput without changing update windows
plan.scope: 1M CE short execution control; WSD/400K LR warmup retained for execution comparison only; not final recipe or full 50+200 performance admission
acceptance: identical per-update sample offsets and token ledgers within each comparison group
finite validation NLL and gradients
record throughput, reserved VRAM and actual microbatch sizes
no automatic promotion to longer training
plan.physical_gpu_comparison_limit: Same host, different physical boards; GPU assignment recorded and device effects are not independently eliminated
